oneOf.description: A browserslist query string to override project configuration.
An array of browserslist query strings.

browserslistConfig.description: Explicit path to a browserslist configuration file.

ignoreFeatures.description: Features to ignore. Element name ("dialog") or attribute pattern ("input[list]").

checkExperimental.description: Whether to warn about experimental elements and attributes.

checkNonStandard.description: Whether to warn about non-standard elements and attributes.
